limitations: PASS validates saved exchanges, counts, citations, historical preservation and bounded publication checks. It is not an app test or proof of decompiler correctness.

Run E is interrupted: three responses survived, including two bodies, but run.json records zero calls. Finalization, per-call timing, original post-run identity, unload and child-exit/cleanup remain unknown.

The eight evidenced method requests include one unresolved selection. Seven planned slots in run B were not executed; run E has one planned unload slot of unknown execution. Neither kind is counted as a received exchange.
The numeric nested sync worker remains unresolved. TTS Java reconstruction and the unselected availability helper leave over-limit reachability unknown.
Raw APK, code bodies, local verifier and historical snapshots stay private. Digests identify retained evidence but do not make it publicly reproducible.
The publication scan is bounded and supplements analyst review. Other lanes and repository-wide validation belong to the integration owner.
